Q1001.reason: The termination notice served immediately after the tenant won the habitability defense is retaliatory eviction, which bars possession.

Q1008.reason: A present bystander who suffers bodily harm can recover for intentional infliction of emotional distress when the actor knew of that presence.

Q938.reason: Effective chest compressions require the patient to lie flat on a firm surface so the sternum can be compressed against a solid base.
